# psycopg 3 talks to Postgres (the "binary" extra bundles the client library,
# so nothing else needs installing). The seed also imports ShopLite's product
# generator (shoplite/db/seed.py), which needs ShopLite's database packages.

psycopg[binary]>=3.2,<4
-r ../shoplite/db/requirements.txt
